about_the_game:
Basketball is back in your hands

The most complete and successful basketball management saga is back. International Basketball Manager 26 puts you once again in charge of your team to prove that you are the best basketball manager in the world. Take full control of your club, define your style, and lead your team to the top.

Manage. Decide. Win

Control every aspect of a professional manager’s life: run training sessions, negotiate transfers, balance budgets, and manage the locker room to keep team chemistry high. Your leadership skills will be the key to achieving glory — or fading into obscurity.

New Feature: National Teams

For the first time in the series, you’ll be able to manage national teams and compete in international tournaments. Qualify during the season to take part in the most prestigious summer competitions and represent your country’s colors against the world’s best teams.

More Leagues. More Teams. More Depth

Compete in over 20 international leagues, featuring hundreds of clubs and thousands of players. Use your scouts wisely, discover young talents, and build a long-term winning project.

Experience the Game Like a Real Coach

Choose how to follow the action:
  • 2D Mode – watch real-time plays unfold and make tactical adjustments instantly.
  • Result Mode – for those who prefer focusing on strategy and post-game analysis.
You can also step in during key moments, make crucial decisions under pressure, and change the outcome of every match.

New leagues for a much deeper game

All leagues already available in previous editions of International Basketball Manager plus:

Club competitions by country:
  • 3rd Spain Division
  • 2nd Turkey Division
  • 2nd Italy Division
  • 1st Poland Division
  • 1st UK Division
  • 1st Brasil Division
  • 1st Portugal Division
Continental club competitions:
  • 1st Europe competition updated to 20 teams and Play-in added.
  • 4th Europe competition
  • 2nd South American competition
National team tournaments:
  • Qualifiers during the season
  • Continental tournaments (Europe, Asia, Africa and America)
  • World Cup
  • Olympic Games

Main Features of International Basketball Manager 26

  • All competitions, teams, and players updated to the 2025/26 season.
  • Option to manage a national team while still coaching your club.
  • 116 national teams added.
  • New major international competitions: Continental Tournaments, World Championship, and Olympic Games. Qualification rounds take place throughout the season.
  • Edit competition, team, and player data with the powerful in-game editor, and share your mods with the IBM community.
  • Convince U18 players to join your club by performing specific actions as you uncover their potential and interest in your project.
  • Compete with one of 357 universities in the U.S. College League.
  • New continental club competitions added.
